runtime_limits: Native replay is an analytic task policy engineering replication, not a learned content neural kernel. Peak individual worker RSS is not aggregate concurrent memory; summed worker wall is not elapsed job wall. CPU is not Joules. Container quota is4CPU/8GiB, not proof of dedicated physical cores.
